system.description:
Favoured weapon: Glaive

Granted power: Choose acid, cold, fire or lightning at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it. Once/day: exhale a 15ft cone of that type (2d6, Reflex save for half). Advantage on saves against fear.

Allegiance: Lawful Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Bahamut in the World of Arneyan wiki.
